posts.title: The Charioteers of Rome
posts.description: The seven marble busts of the charioteers in Palazzimo Massimo were discovered in 1889 during the construction of the Trastevere rail station. Some charioteers became enormously popular. People followed their careers, celebrated their victories, and developed fierce loyalties to the racing factions they represented. posts.title: The Trouble with Aristotle
posts.description: Carlo Rovelli, in his book There Are Places in the World Where Rules Are Less Important Than Kindness, wants us to take Aristotle seriously as a scientist.
